questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
questions.solution: D)The correct spelling of ‘Accomodate’ is ‘Accommodate,’ which means “to provide space or to fit in with the needs or wishes of someone” समायोजित करना, स्थान प्रदान करना.

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
questions.solution: D)The incorrect spelling among the given options is ‘Addventure’. The correct spelling is ‘Adventure’, which means “an unusual and exciting, typically hazardous, experience or activity” साहसिक कार्य।

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
questions.solution: D)The correct spelling of 'Ilegal' is'Illegal,' which means "contrary to or forbidden by law" अवैध.

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
questions.solution: B)The correct spelling of ‘Definately’is ‘Definitely’ which means "without doubt; certainly" निस्संदेह, निश्चित रूप से

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
questions.solution: B)The correct spelling of'Swindel'is 'Swindle' which means "to cheat or defraud someone" धोखा देना, ठगना.

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
questions.solution: D) The correct spelling of 'Prisonor' is 'Prisoner,' which means “a person legally held in prison as a punishment for crimes they have committed or while awaiting trial” क़ैदी, बंदी
